headline: EXCITEBIKE picks its own lap count; FLOOR BOSS keeps its corners clear
lede: Slot b resurrected a dead lane's ship and merged YOUR LAPS, while slot a landed the corner-clearance law — after both lanes built it, which the board is now rectifying.

notes.text: EXCITEBIKE: YOUR LAPS — the custom bay gained a LAP tool (1–8, default 2). The designer's number rides the codec, save/reload, the splash badge and the start line; league tracks keep the house two-lap book byte-identical. Merged as 32f4556 (#2630), resumed from a corpse at step 1b, re-verified 385/385 before landing.

FLOOR BOSS: NO CORNER STACKS — racking the cell that faces a tight elbow is refused when both arms run tight with open mouths: a parked service cart would choke two aisles at once (the real warehouse corner-clearance code). Slot a's #2634 merged as 583cc59.

Two lanes implemented the fifth click-point law inside one hour (#2629 vs #2634). The merge slot took one; the duplicate is closed with the diff of law recorded on #2627. Lesson: the claim, not the branch, is the lock — build without claiming and you both own it, and neither knows.

main's rule-5 freeze (red nightly ce5d45f) held all evening and lifted exactly at the fix's cancellation; both merges landed within thirteen minutes of green. Nightly coverage on main is owed once 583cc59 is fresh.
